session.goalText: Fix queueHistory.test.cjs isolation: races with live app's global history.jsonl
session.openingPrompt:
src/main/__tests__/queueHistory.test.cjs's HISTORY_PATH resolves to the real global
~/.claude/session-manager/scheduled-plans/history.jsonl (see queueHistory.cjs:24,
os.homedir()-based), not an isolated per-test temp path.

When a live Electron instance of Session Manager is running on the same machine, its
scheduler.cjs actively writes to that same global file, racing the test's beforeEach/afterEach
unlink calls. This causes 4 tests in that file to fail with real production data instead of
the expected empty state:
- "readHistory respects limit and returns [] when file is absent"
- "historyTerminalBySlug: returns an empty map when history.jsonl is absent"
- two more in the same run

Reproduced 2026-08-02 while running the /builder release pipeline's gate step (npm run
test:unit) with a live app instance running (PID had started 12:14 that day) — confirmed by
rerunning `npx vitest run src/main/__tests__/queueHistory.test.cjs` in isolation and seeing
the same 4 failures consistently, then confirming a live Electron process for this app was
running and its scheduler-mcp-server.cjs was active. This is a real test-isolation bug, not
a flake — it blocks the npm-publish gate any time a developer runs test:unit while also
running the app itself (the normal dogfooding workflow for this project).

Fix: make queueHistory.cjs's HISTORY_PATH overridable (env var or a factory/constructor
param), and have queueHistory.test.cjs point it at a fresh os.tmpdir() path per test run
instead of the real machine-global file. Verify by running test:unit both with and without
a live Electron instance of the app running concurrently — both must pass identically.

Fix: make queueHistory.cjs's HISTORY_PATH overridable (env var or a factory/constructor

Fixed and committed (`8b853e5`).

Root cause was two-fold, not just the reported HISTORY_PATH race:
1. `HISTORY_PATH` pointed at the real global `history.jsonl`, racing a live Electron instance's `scheduler.cjs`.
2. `historyPaths()` also federates in every real project's own `session-manager-operations/scheduler/state/history.jsonl` shard (via `stateCwds()`), which leaked actual production PRD history from other projects on this machine into "file absent" assertions — reproducible even without a live app running.

Fix: `SM_HISTORY_PATH_OVERRIDE` env var redirects `HISTORY_PATH` to an isolated tmpdir path and, when set, `historyPaths()` skips the federated per-project shards entirely. `queueHistory.test.cjs` now sets a fresh override per test run.

Verified: all 20 tests in `queueHistory.test.cjs` pass while a live Electron instance (multiple in fact) is running on this machine — the exact repro condition — plus the full `src/main/__tests__/` suite (426 tests) and `npm run typecheck` are clean.
`origin/main` already had commit `8b853e5` — it was already pushed. Nothing further to do; the fix is live on the remote.

const path = require('path');
const fsp = require('fs').promises;
const { HISTORY_RETENTION_MS } = require('./schedulerConfig.cjs');
const { projectHistoryPath, stateCwds } = require('./queueStore.cjs');

// resolved via queueStore.cjs). Old rows stay readable from here; new appends
// go to the owning project's shard (entries without a cwd still land here so
// nothing is ever dropped).
const HISTORY_PATH = path.join(os.homedir(), '.claude', 'session-manager', 'scheduled-plans', 'history.jsonl');

  for (const cwd of stateCwds()) {
    try { paths.push(projectHistoryPath(cwd)); } catch { /* unusable cwd */ }

  paths.push(HISTORY_PATH);

function historyPathFor(entry) {
  if (entry && entry.cwd) {
    try { return projectHistoryPath(entry.cwd); } catch { /* fall through */ }

}

function isFixPlanSlug(slug) {
  return /^\d+-fix-/.test(slug);
}

function jobKey(job) {

}

/**

 * and `toArchive` (moves to history.jsonl). A completed/failed job archives

  return map;
}

  HISTORY_PATH,
  partitionJobs,
  appendHistory,
  readHistory,
  historyTerminalBySlug,

// Moves terminal (completed/failed) scheduler jobs older than a retention
// window out of the hot queue.json jobs[] array into an append-only
// history.jsonl sidecar. Keeps queue.json small (mutation cost, broadcast
// payload size, pickNextBatch/reconcile scan cost all scale with jobs[]
// length) while preserving full history for the renderer's History view.
//
// Kept pure where fs isn't unavoidable: partitionJobs takes an injected
// `nowMs` and `opts` so it's testable without touching the real clock or
// disk. appendHistory/readHistory own the actual fs I/O.

const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');
const fsp = require('fs').promises;
const { HISTORY_RETENTION_MS } = require('./schedulerConfig.cjs');
const { projectHistoryPath, stateCwds } = require('./queueStore.cjs');

// Legacy global sidecar — READ-ONLY since 2026-07-31 (federated per-project
// history under <cwd>/session-manager-operations/scheduler/state/history.jsonl,
// resolved via queueStore.cjs). Old rows stay readable from here; new appends
// go to the owning project's shard (entries without a cwd still land here so
// nothing is ever dropped).
//
// Overridable via SM_HISTORY_PATH_OVERRIDE so queueHistory.test.cjs can point
// this at an isolated tmpdir path instead of racing a live Electron
// instance's scheduler.cjs, which writes this same machine-global file.
const HISTORY_PATH = process.env.SM_HISTORY_PATH_OVERRIDE
  || path.join(os.homedir(), '.claude', 'session-manager', 'scheduled-plans', 'history.jsonl');

/** Every history file currently in play: each project's shard + the legacy global. */
function historyPaths() {
  const paths = [];
  for (const cwd of stateCwds()) {
    try { paths.push(projectHistoryPath(cwd)); } catch { /* unusable cwd */ }
  }
  paths.push(HISTORY_PATH);
  return paths;
}

function historyPathFor(entry) {
  if (entry && entry.cwd) {
    try { return projectHistoryPath(entry.cwd); } catch { /* fall through */ }
  }
  return HISTORY_PATH;
}

function isFixPlanSlug(slug) {
  return /^\d+-fix-/.test(slug);
}

function jobKey(job) {
  return `${job?.slug ?? ''}|${job?.runId ?? ''}`;
}

/**
 * O(n) over `jobs`. Splits terminal jobs into `hot` (stays in queue.json)
 * and `toArchive` (moves to history.jsonl). A completed/failed job archives
 * only when ALL of:
 *   - status is 'completed' or 'failed'
 *   - finishedAt parses and is older than opts.retentionMs (default
 *     HISTORY_RETENTION_MS)
 *   - it is not the healTargetForFix() parent of a pending/running fix-plan
 *     job (NN-fix-<slug> relationships stay hot together so the fix-plan
 *     can still find and promote its original when it completes)
 */
function partitionJobs(jobs, nowMs, opts = {}) {
  const retentionMs = opts.retentionMs ?? HISTORY_RETENTION_MS;
  const list = Array.isArray(jobs) ? jobs : [];

  // Slugs of jobs that a still-pending/running fix-plan is going to try to
  // heal (see healTargetForFix in scheduler.cjs — same regex, kept in sync).
  const protectedSlugs = new Set();
  for (const j of list) {
    if (!j || !isFixPlanSlug(j.slug)) continue;
    if (j.status !== 'pending' && j.status !== 'running') continue;
    protectedSlugs.add(j.slug.replace(/^(\d+)-fix-/, '$1-'));
  }

  const hot = [];
  const toArchive = [];
  for (const j of list) {
    if (!j) continue;
    const finishedMs = j.finishedAt ? Date.parse(j.finishedAt) : NaN;
    const archivable =
      (j.status === 'completed' || j.status === 'failed') &&
      Number.isFinite(finishedMs) &&
      (nowMs - finishedMs) > retentionMs &&
      !protectedSlugs.has(j.slug);
    if (archivable) toArchive.push(j);
    else hot.push(j);
  }
  return { hot, toArchive };
}

 * disk. The dedupe exists for crash-safety: reconcile() appends BEFORE
 * dropping archived jobs from state.jobs, so a crash between those two steps
 * replays the same batch through partitionJobs on the next boot — dedupe
 * here is what stops that replay from double-writing history.
 */
async function appendHistory(entries) {
  const list = Array.isArray(entries) ? entries.filter(Boolean) : [];
  if (list.length === 0) return { appended: 0 };

  // Federated: each entry appends to its own project's shard (fallback: the
  // legacy global file for cwd-less rows). Dedupe stays per target file.
  const byPath = new Map();
  for (const e of list) {
    const target = historyPathFor(e);
    if (!byPath.has(target)) byPath.set(target, []);
    byPath.get(target).push(e);

  for (const [target, group] of byPath) {
    let existingText = '';
    try {

        }

    if (fresh.length === 0) continue;

    await fsp.mkdir(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
    const text = fresh.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n') + '\n';
